classification.difficultyReason: Identify the negative gradient and intercept 4 in the equation, then select the descending graph with that labelled intercept.

content.prompt: Which of the following best represents the graph of $y=-3x+4$

spec.description: Four schematic graphs in one horizontal row, labelled A–D. A and C descend; B and D ascend. A and B have y-intercept 4; C and D have y-intercept −3. Unlabelled geometry is schematic, not an additional numerical given. Origin O is omitted under the house graph convention.
spec.mathematics: A: negative gradient, y-intercept 4. B: positive gradient, y-intercept 4. C: negative gradient, y-intercept −3. D: positive gradient, y-intercept −3.
spec.answerVisibility: All four options are permanent student givens; no option is marked correct.

answer.worked:
The gradient is $-3$, so the line slopes down from left to right. The $y$-intercept is $4$. Graph A has both features.

Correct answer: A.
